address_migration.basis: User explicitly updated the local model IP to 192.168.1.11 on 2026-10-31 (local date) and requested it be recorded in local model operations. Port, model and credentials are unchanged; retain the combined experiment history.

dispatch_policy.basis: User repeatedly requests substantially higher actual local-model concurrency. Remove serial preparation/review idle gaps by dispatching complete real source tasks directly from their owners.

concurrency.target_scope: Operating target for real unfinished source tasks; not an observed concurrency result or a newly implemented scheduler.
concurrency.increase_when: Raise real concurrency beyond the initial target while complete independent work is ready and observed service headroom remains.
concurrency.overlap: Prepare, review and compile candidates while owners dispatch other complete independent implementations and necessary consumers/probes; build holds do not block source HTTP.
concurrency.source_preparation: Reuse source_files plus task_path, or stable_source_path, in the existing caller; no central packet ACK or additional indexing prerequisite.
concurrency.reporting: Report current real in-flight requests and actual BEGIN/END windows separately from cumulative use, operational targets and runtime decision HTTP.
concurrency.avoid: Do not fill quotas, replay completed work, send empty probes, or count monitoring and summaries as model tasks.

prefer: Independent real implementation methods and small contract changes with exact declarations and consumers
Actual compiler or behaviour diagnostics, with a narrower corrective request when useful
Prepare the next real bounded request while reviewing or testing the previous candidate
calibration: Track input scope, hints, rounds, actual compilation and behaviour, owner correction cost, elapsed time and final adoption
Do not infer reasoning limits from HTTP errors, missing tool parser, truncation or a single success or failure
After repeated API invention or semantic failures, assign the full implementation to the owner and reserve a smaller independently verifiable method for the model
Explore greater difficulty offline when current evidence supports it; do not make exploration a live-game prerequisite
currently_owner_led: Complete ASM ABI and memory layout reconstruction across multiple source files
Full continuity recovery graphs and archive helpers requiring unsupplied or repeatedly invented APIs
avoid: Reposting an already completed implementation for retrospective credit
Unneeded calls, fixed per-agent quotas, or indefinitely waiting on a model before live recovery

latest_connection_observation.scope: real source candidate; connection observation does not grant compilation, adoption, performance or Game credit

prompting.system_template: You are a Java engineering collaborator. Use only the supplied current source and contracts. Return a precise candidate or analysis for the final task. Do not invent APIs, missing facts, successful tests, or game outcomes. Distinguish observations from assumptions. Follow the requested output format.
message_order: user: current stable source and contracts in deterministic order
user: changing task, diagnostics, requested output, and review feedback
source_order: shared contracts and stable API declarations
prompting.metadata_location: timestamps, request ids, attempt numbers, and local paths for receipts stay outside the model prefix unless needed by the task
prompting.cache_semantics: Reuse actual unchanged source text; update changed sources normally. Prefix caching primarily targets time to first token, not decode throughput.

transient_retries.scope: model HTTP requests only; never replay game/native actions
transient_retries.on_partial_stream: retain failed attempt and discard partial candidate; retry complete unchanged request
transient_retries.nonretryable: do not retry permanent request/schema/authentication errors without correcting the request
transient_retries.during_backoff: continue independent work; do not block the live CK3 path or fall back to port 8000
